mentions.name: LiveRound
mentions.description: An AI mock interview tool for system design interview preparation. Users practice system design interviews with AI to learn how to assemble studied material into a working design under interview conditions; it is currently in beta with free access offered in exchange for feedback.
mentions.problem: Preparing for system design interviews involves lots of revising and learning material, but at the actual interview the author struggled to put that knowledge together to design the system given.
mentions.audience: People preparing for job interviews, specifically candidates doing system design interview prep.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on ai interviews for system design prep.

I’m currently in a beta phase giving people free access for feedback. If you’re prepping for interviews and want to give it a try let me know

https://liveround.ai/
mentions.author: tarrydev13
